kind: Claude Code plugin with model output

pull_requests.title: feat(skills): add leaf-pest-check for identifying pests
pull_requests.body: New skill: when someone describes spots, holes, sticky residue, webbing or small insects on their plant's leaves, leaf-pest-check names the likely pest and how to treat it. Its reply opens with 'Leaf pest check:'.

pull_requests.title: feat(skills): let houseplant-care answer light and soil questions
pull_requests.body: People asking where to put a plant or which soil to use got no skill at all. houseplant-care's description now also covers light and soil, so those questions reach it.
